seo.title: What Is Included on Scenic?
seo.metaDescription: Discover what is included on Scenic Cruises, from luxury suites and butler service to fine dining, premium beverages, Wi-Fi, shore excursions, and expedition experiences.
seo.keywords: What Is Included on Scenic, Scenic cruise inclusions, Scenic all-inclusive cruises, Scenic luxury cruise benefits, Scenic Discovery Yacht inclusions, Scenic river cruise inclusions, Scenic expedition cruises

hero.title: What Is Included on Scenic?
hero.subtitle: One of the biggest reasons travelers choose Scenic is its truly all-inclusive approach to luxury travel.

intro.heading: One of the Biggest Reasons Travelers Choose Scenic
paragraphs: Whether you're sailing on a Scenic River Cruise or aboard one of Scenic's Discovery Yachts, your fare includes far more than just your suite and meals.
From personalized butler service to premium beverages, immersive excursions, gratuities, and luxury accommodations, Scenic removes the stress of planning so you can simply enjoy your journey.
Here's everything you can expect when sailing with Scenic across ocean, river, and expedition journeys worldwide.

accommodations.title: Luxury Accommodations
accommodations.subtitle: Every Scenic voyage begins with elegant accommodations designed for comfort and relaxation.
accommodations.footnote: Guests aboard Scenic Eclipse enjoy all-veranda suites with butler service, while Scenic river ships feature elegantly appointed balcony suites.

butlerService.title: Butler Service
butlerService.subtitle: One of Scenic's signature luxury features is personalized butler service for every guest.
butlerService.footnote: Scenic Eclipse provides butler service for every suite, with higher suite categories enjoying expanded personalized privileges.

fineDining.title: Fine Dining
fineDining.subtitle: Dining is included throughout your voyage, featuring world-class culinary creations across multiple venues.
fineDining.footnote: Scenic Eclipse offers up to 10 dining venues, while Scenic River Cruises feature elegant onboard restaurants and specialty regional experiences.

premiumBeverages.title: Premium Beverages
premiumBeverages.subtitle: Guests can enjoy beverages throughout the day without worrying about additional bar charges.

shoreExcursions.title: Shore Excursions
shoreExcursions.subtitle: Scenic includes a wide variety of excursions designed to immerse travelers deeply in each destination.
shoreExcursions.footnote: Many itineraries also include Scenic Freechoice excursions, allowing guests to personalize their day at no extra cost.

scenicEnrich.title: Scenic Enrich Experiences
scenicEnrich.subtitle: Scenic Enrich offers exclusive, once-in-a-lifetime cultural events unavailable to the general public.
scenicEnrich.footnote: These curated private events provide memorable, authentic moments unique to Scenic guests.

expeditionExperiences.title: Expedition Experiences
expeditionExperiences.subtitle: Guests sailing aboard Scenic Eclipse Discovery Yachts enjoy cutting-edge exploration tools led by world-class naturalists.
expeditionExperiences.footnote: Optional helicopter and submarine excursions are available on select voyages for an additional charge.

wellnessAndFitness.title: Wellness & Fitness
wellnessAndFitness.subtitle: Scenic offers exceptional wellness spaces designed to rejuvenate mind and body after a day of discovery.
wellnessAndFitness.footnote: Access to all wellness facilities is included; specialized spa treatments and salon services are available for an additional fee.

goodToKnow.title: Good to Know: Everyday Luxuries
goodToKnow.subtitle: A few more essential inclusions worth knowing before you sail.

items.title: Complimentary Wi-Fi
items.description: Complimentary Wi-Fi is included throughout your Scenic cruise, allowing guests to stay connected seamlessly while traveling across remote waters and rivers.

items.title: All Gratuities Included
items.description: Unlike many cruise lines, Scenic includes all onboard gratuities in your cruise fare. Guests never need to budget separately for tipping or service charges.

items.title: Included Airport Transfers
items.description: Many Scenic itineraries include airport transfers when flights are arranged according to Scenic's booking guidelines, ensuring smooth arrival and departure.

notIncluded.title: What's Not Included?
notIncluded.subtitle: While Scenic is among the industry's most inclusive cruise lines, some specialized experiences involve additional costs:
items: Rare vintage reserve wines and ultra-premium spirits

valueProposition.title: Why Scenic Offers Exceptional Value
valueProposition.lead: Although Scenic cruises may have a higher upfront price than some competitors, the overall value is exceptional because so many services are already included.
valueProposition.description: Instead of paying separately for beverages, gratuities, excursions, specialty dining, and luxury amenities, guests enjoy one comprehensive vacation price. For many travelers, this creates a more relaxing and transparent luxury travel experience.

faqs.question: Are Scenic cruises all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic is one of the most all-inclusive luxury cruise brands, with accommodations, dining, beverages, Wi-Fi, gratuities, and many excursions included.

faqs.question: Does Scenic include alcoholic beverages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Premium wines, beer, spirits, cocktails, soft drinks, and specialty coffees are generally included throughout your cruise.

faqs.question: Is butler service included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Butler service is included on Scenic Eclipse and available on many Scenic River Cruise suite categories.

faqs.question: Are gratuities included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic includes onboard gratuities in the cruise fare.

faqs.question: Does Scenic include Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is included for guests.

faqs.question: Are shore excursions included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic includes a variety of guided shore excursions, including Scenic Freechoice experiences on many itineraries.

faqs.question: What are Scenic Enrich experiences?
faqs.answer: Scenic Enrich experiences are exclusive cultural events, private performances, and special access experiences included on select itineraries.

faqs.question: Are specialty restaurants included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most onboard dining venues and specialty restaurants are included in your cruise fare.

faqs.question: Does Scenic include airport transfers?
faqs.answer: Many itineraries include airport transfers when flights are booked according to Scenic's guidelines.

faqs.question: Are helicopter and submarine excursions included?
faqs.answer: No. These premium experiences aboard Scenic Eclipse are typically optional and available for an additional charge.

faqs.question: Are spa treatments included?
faqs.answer: No. Access to wellness facilities is included, but spa treatments and salon services generally cost extra.

faqs.question: Is Scenic worth the price?
faqs.answer: For travelers seeking luxury, convenience, and transparent pricing, Scenic offers excellent value through its comprehensive all-inclusive experience.
